meta.title: Ice Cream Hill | Video Studio
meta.description: Video production studio for brands and artists. From social content to music videos, factory shoots to product films, we plan, shoot and deliver.

items.title: Social media content series
items.body: Short video and photo series in one visual language, built around a campaign or a season. One shoot day turns into weeks of posts.

items.title: Product film and product photography
items.body: Films and photos that show a product through light, texture and use. We plan separate framings for e-commerce, catalog and ads.

items.title: Factory and facility shoots
items.body: We film production lines, machines and people without interrupting the workflow. Used for corporate films, recruiting and trade fair screens.

items.title: Trade fairs and events
items.body: We cover the booth, the stage and the crowd through the day and deliver short edits the same day. A longer recap follows after the event.

items.title: Music video
items.body: Concept, shot plan and edit built from the idea of the song. Performance, story or a mix of both.

items.title: Portrait and editorial
items.body: Portrait series in the studio or on location. Framing and light are planned for covers, press and profiles.

items.title: Campaign shoot
items.body: Video and photo in one go for an album, a tour or a personal brand launch. Every channel speaks the same visual language.

items.title: Documentary and explainer
items.body: Films that tell the story of a person, a craft or a process through interviews and observation. From short to long form.

steps.title: Brief
steps.body: We talk about what we are shooting, where it will be used and when it is due.

steps.title: Planning
steps.body: Concept, location, cast and shot list are settled. No surprises on the day.

steps.title: Shoot
steps.body: We shoot on the planned day, with the planned list.

steps.title: Edit and grade
steps.body: Edit, color and sound are finished by the same team, revisions come together in one flow.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.body: Files in the right size and format for every channel they will run on.

studio.label: Studio
studio.title: From idea to delivery, one team.
paragraphs: Ice Cream Hill is a video production studio. With brands and artists, we shape the idea together, plan the shoot and finish the edit and color ourselves. Work is never handed from one team to another: the team that hears the brief makes the delivery.

A restaurant menu, a factory line, a music video or a campaign: on every job we first ask where it will be used. Framing, length and format follow from that answer, and the shoot day is built around that plan.

approach.title: Planning
approach.body: Concept, location, cast and shot list are settled before the shoot. Everyone arrives on set with the same plan.

approach.title: Shoot
approach.body: Video and photo on the same day, in the same visual language. When needed, we cut quick edits on site.

approach.title: Edit and grade
approach.body: Edit, color and sound are finished by the same team. Delivery is sized for every channel.
